name: bifrost-ci-newman
description: Pinned newman + reporter installer for release-pipeline CI. The lockfile next to this file carries SHA-512 integrity hashes used by `npm ci`, which satisfies Scorecard's pinned-dependencies-by-hash check. Overrides mirror tests/e2e/api/package.json to pin transitive deps with known CVEs (handlebars, jose, lodash, etc.) to patched releases.
